description: 25 LLM physics error class coverage entries for detection during verification

error_classes.name: CG Coefficient Sign Error
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify triangle inequality, m-values sum. Spot-check one CG against Varshalovich tables.

error_classes.name: Metric Signature Flip
error_classes.detection_hint: Trace metric through every equation. Check sign of contraction g_μν g^μν = d.

error_classes.name: Ward Identity Violation
error_classes.detection_hint: Replace ε^μ → k^μ. Check S-matrix cancellation. Use ward_identity_check.py script.

error_classes.name: Wrong Eigenvalue Count
error_classes.detection_hint: Count must match Hilbert space dimension. Verify degeneracy structure.

error_classes.name: Gauge Parameter in Observable
error_classes.detection_hint: ξ must cancel from physical observables. Check all final expressions for gauge parameter remnants.

error_classes.name: Wrong Fourier Convention
error_classes.detection_hint: Check 2π factors in Fourier transforms. Verify transform-inverse pair normalizes correctly.

error_classes.name: Missing Renormalization Counterterm
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify all divergent integrals have corresponding counterterms. Check renormalization scheme consistency.

error_classes.name: Unitarity Violation
error_classes.detection_hint: Check |a_J| ≤ 1 for partial wave amplitudes. Verify S-matrix unitarity S†S = I.

error_classes.name: Causality Violation
error_classes.detection_hint: Check propagator pole structure. Verify no response before stimulus.

error_classes.name: Negative Probability / Density
error_classes.detection_hint: Check all probability distributions for positivity. Verify density matrix eigenvalues ≥ 0.

error_classes.name: Wrong Asymptotic/Limit Behavior
error_classes.detection_hint: Compute actual limit using sympy.limit(). Compare against claimed behavior.

error_classes.name: Dimension Mismatch
error_classes.detection_hint: Track dimensions through all expressions. Verify LHS and RHS dimensions match.

error_classes.name: Order of Magnitude Error
error_classes.detection_hint: Spot-check numerical values against known scales. Verify unit conversions.

error_classes.name: Unintended Symmetry Breaking
catches: expression not invariant under stated symmetry
error_classes.detection_hint: Apply symmetry transform to expression. Verify invariance using sympy.simplify().

error_classes.name: Wrong Matsubara Convention
error_classes.detection_hint: Check ω_n = 2nπ/β (bosonic) vs ω_n = (2n+1)π/β (fermionic). Verify period consistency.

error_classes.name: Wrong Spin-Statistics Connection
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify commutation relations match spin. Check Fermi-Dirac vs Bose-Einstein distribution usage.

error_classes.name: Wrong Coupling Sign
error_classes.detection_hint: Trace coupling sign through Lagrangian to physical result. Check attractive/repulsive consistency.

error_classes.name: Wrong Normalization
error_classes.detection_hint: Check normalization of wavefunctions, propagators, partition functions. Verify ∫|ψ|² = 1.

error_classes.name: Wrong Propagator Structure
error_classes.detection_hint: Check pole positions and residues. Verify numerator matches field type (scalar, vector, spinor).

error_classes.name: Wrong Thermodynamic Limit
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify correct limit order (N→∞ first, then other limits). Check extensive/intensive properties.

error_classes.name: Wrong Renormalization Scheme
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify renormalization scheme matches claim. Convert between schemes if needed.

error_classes.name: Wrong Canonical Quantization
error_classes.detection_hint: Check [x, p] = iℏ (or appropriate units). Verify operator ordering matches convention.

error_classes.name: Wrong Convergence Claim
error_classes.detection_hint: Test numerical convergence at boundary values. Check analyticity domain.

error_classes.name: Wrong Boundary Condition
error_classes.detection_hint: Verify boundary conditions match physical setup. Check consistency with equations.

error_classes.name: Missing Physical Effect
error_classes.detection_hint: Check whether all known physical effects in the regime are included. Compare against complete literature results.
